description: This file defines a mock class 'GstWrapperMock' for the 'IGstWrapper' interface, using Google Mock. It provides mocked methods for various GStreamer-related functions, enabling unit testing of components that depend on GStreamer functionality. The class is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and includes methods for creating and setting up GStreamer caps and structures, as well as handling GStreamer elements, pads, buffers, and messages.

classes.name: GstWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstWrapper interface for unit testing GStreamer interactions.

methods.name: gstCapsNewSimple
methods.description: Creates a new GstCaps with a simple media type and properties, using variable arguments to set properties.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets properties on a GstCaps object using variable arguments, supporting multiple data types.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and properties, supporting multiple data types.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GstStructure using variable arguments, supporting string and uint types.
